description: This file provides integration with AWS Secrets Manager and AWS KMS for decrypting secrets, including classes and functions for environment validation, KMS client loading, secret decryption, and environment variable rewriting.

classes.name: AWSKeyManagementService_V2
classes.description: Class for decrypting keys from AWS KMS, with environment validation and secret decryption methods.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Checks for required environment variables and license presence.

methods.name: load_aws_kms
methods.description: Initializes AWS KMS client if enabled.

methods.name: decrypt_value
methods.description: Decrypts a secret value from AWS KMS using the environment variable.

methods.name: decrypt_env_var
methods.description: Rewrites environment variables with decrypted AWS KMS secrets.
